{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# Note: The values are already in format '123.45', no commas to strip
# But let's verify and convert
print("First few revenue values (before):")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].astype(float)

print("First few revenue values (after):")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Focus on loyal customers only
loyal_mask = df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
print(f"Loyal customers: {loyal_mask.sum()}")

# Subset to loyal customers
df_loyal = df[loyal_mask]

# Check converted values for loyal
print("Converted in loyal:")
print(df_loyal['converted'].value_counts())

# Compute fraction converted
n_converted = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
n_total = len(df_loyal)
fraction = n_converted / n_total
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction}")"}
